description: The bar chart illustrates the proportion of real-user demand for different input and output ranges in the Wildchat dataset. The vertical axis represents the number of users, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 120,000. The horizontal axis categorizes the data into six groups: 2K-Input, 4K-Input, 8K-Input, 16K-Input, 2K-Output, 4K-Output, 8K-Output, and 16K-Output. The 4K-Input group has the highest demand with 108,494 users, followed by the 2K-Input group with 78,188 users. The 16K-Input group has the lowest demand with 4,247 users. The 4K-Output group has the second-highest demand with 37,884 users, while the 2K-Output group has 9,320 users. The 8K-Output group has 14,065 users, and the 16K-Output group has 4,832 users. The chart uses solid color fill for input demand and slash fill for output demand, with each group represented by a distinct color and pattern.
